subject: mdl: always enable and make it read only in nextgen (#62865)
summary: This commit centralizes MDL enable checks behind `vardef.IsMDLEnabled()` / `vardef.SetEnableMDL()` and makes MDL always-on + read-only for `nextgen` builds (compile-time build tag). DDL job scheduler/worker, schema-version syncer, infoschema MDL check loop, and schema validator now gate MDL behavior via the helper, which forces MDL enabled in nextgen while keeping classic behavior unchanged. Reviewed the touched DDL/infoschema MDL sync/state-machine paths for correctness/concurrency/metadata consistency and found no remaining Blocker/High issues; later history up to `upstream/master` shows only a follow-up refactor of nextgen SET-variable checks, not a correctness fix to these DDL/infoschema behaviors.
